description: Parameters of the Cosserat rod model of the soft pneumatic actuator, as used for the simulation of the PINN training data and for all experiments. Diagonals of the compliance matrix C [shear x, shear y, dilatation, bending x, bending y, torsion], the damping matrix D (in s) and the cross-sectional mass matrix M (in kg/m and kg m); M_tip is the tip mass as additional line density between the last two nodes (kg/m). Identified (T-RO, Table II): ref_length, tip mass, C[3] (bending compliance), C[2] (dilatation compliance), D[3] (bending damping); see README.
